figures.shows: The exported Open World game ten seconds after its start, its tour flying the camera over the forest
figures.caption: Ten seconds after its start, the exported game plays its start scene. Its tour flies the camera over a forest beside a dark hill, under the game's own clock at the top left. No editor surrounds it.
figures.alt: A game window showing green and blue trees on a slope of grass beside a dark hill under a pale sky. A clock and the word Tour stand at the top left, a line of controls at the bottom, and no panels surround it.
